quote: D1. The charge conjugation on the light neutrino is absent — substantive. The paper writes the light-neutrino piece of the $W_R$ lepton current as $\overline{\nu^{c}_{m}}X_{\ell m}\,W^+_{R\mu}\gamma^\mu P_R\,\ell^-$ (L296). The file carries `vlbar.XN.Ga[mu].ProjP.l`, i.e. $\bar\nu$ with no conjugation, and the reconstruction records that the file holds no `CC` operator anywhere (§0, §5.1).
note: D1 correctly locates the defect in the LWRl light-neutrino bilinear, correctly identifies it as a missing charge-conjugation (fermion-number-violating structure turned fermion-number-conserving), and rates it substantive, so the write-up sends a physicist straight to the right term and the right kind of error.
